description: Point-in-time asset price with source proof ($0.05 USDC per call). First call (no payment_signature) returns the payment challenge; pay the exact USDC on Solana, then call again with payment_signature.

id.description: Asset id, e.g. bitcoin, ethereum, solana, chainlink

payment_signature.description: Optional. Omit on the first call to receive the payment challenge. After sending the exact USDC amount on Solana mainnet to the pay_to wallet, call again with this set to the Solana transaction signature of your payment.

name: get_price
